where.if: AND ( code.code_masked LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR batch.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rr.plan_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redeem_record ( redeem_code_id, batch_id, plan_id, user_id, plan_name, duration_days, redeemed_at, redeem_ip ) VALUES ( #{redeemCodeId}, #{batchId}, #{planId}, #{userId}, #{planName}, #{durationDays}, #{redeemedAt}, #{redeemIp} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redeem_record rr LEFT JOIN redeem_code code ON code.id = rr.redeem_code_id LEFT JOIN redeem_code_batch batch ON batch.id = rr.batch_id LEFT JOIN user_account account ON account.id = rr.user_id LEFT JOIN product_plan plan ON plan.id = rr.plan_id LEFT JOIN product product ON product.id = plan.product_id

SELECT rr.id, rr.redeem_code_id, code.code_masked, rr.batch_id, batch.batch_no, batch.channel, rr.plan_id, rr.plan_name, rr.duration_days, plan.product_id, product.product_code, product.product_name, rr.user_id, account.username, account.nickname, rr.redeemed_at, rr.redeem_ip FROM redeem_record rr LEFT JOIN redeem_code code ON code.id = rr.redeem_code_id LEFT JOIN redeem_code_batch batch ON batch.id = rr.batch_id LEFT JOIN user_account account ON account.id = rr.user_id LEFT JOIN product_plan plan ON plan.id = rr.plan_id LEFT JOIN product product ON product.id = plan.product_id
ORDER BY rr.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
